# cvc5_parser：链接 cvc5 C API 解析 SMT-LIB，输出 JSON（含 ast_node_count）
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(cvc5_parser CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# 本目录下：优先 cvc5-install（从源码 make install 得到，兼容旧 glibc；可能是 .a 或 .so），否则预编译包 cvc5-Linux-* / cvc5-*-static
set(CVC5_DIR "")
set(CVC5_INSTALL_LIB "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cvc5-install/lib")
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cvc5-install/include/cvc5/cvc5.h")
  if(EXISTS "${CVC5_INSTALL_LIB}/libcvc5.a" OR EXISTS "${CVC5_INSTALL_LIB}/libcvc5.so" OR EXISTS "${CVC5_INSTALL_LIB}/libcvc5.so.1")
    set(CVC5_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cvc5-install")
  endif()
endif()
if(NOT CVC5_DIR)
  file(GLOB CVC5_PREBUILT "cvc5-Linux-*" "cvc5-*-static")
  if(CVC5_PREBUILT)
    list(GET CVC5_PREBUILT 0 CVC5_DIR)
  endif()
endif()
if(CVC5_DIR)
    set(CVC5_INCLUDE "${CVC5_DIR}/include")
    set(CVC5_LIB "${CVC5_DIR}/lib")
    set(CVC5_LIBS cvc5 cvc5parser picpolyxx picpoly cadical gmpxx gmp)
    # 若为共享库（cvc5-install 默认安装 .so），运行时需能找到 lib 目录
    if(EXISTS "${CVC5_DIR}/lib/libcvc5.so" OR EXISTS "${CVC5_DIR}/lib/libcvc5.so.1")
      set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH "${CVC5_DIR}/lib")
      set(CMAKE_BUILD_RPATH "${CVC5_DIR}/lib")
      set(CMAKE_INSTALL_RPATH_USE_LINK_PATH TRUE)
    endif()
else()
    set(CVC5_INCLUDE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
    set(CVC5_LIB "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib")
    set(CVC5_LIBS cvc5 cvc5parser picpolyxx picpoly cadical gmpxx gmp)
endif()

add_executable(cvc5_parser cvc5_parser.cpp)
target_include_directories(cvc5_parser PRIVATE ${CVC5_INCLUDE})
target_link_directories(cvc5_parser PRIVATE ${CVC5_LIB})
# 预编译包若在 glibc 2.38+ 下构建会引用 __isoc23_strtol 等，Conda 环境可能链接到旧 glibc；显式链接系统 libc 以解析这些符号
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "Linux")
  target_link_directories(cvc5_parser PRIVATE /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu /usr/lib64 /usr/lib)
  target_link_libraries(cvc5_parser PRIVATE ${CVC5_LIBS} c)
else()
  target_link_libraries(cvc5_parser PRIVATE ${CVC5_LIBS})
endif()
# 若使用 libcxx-static 预编译包，请用 clang 并加：-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-stdlib=libc++" -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-stdlib=libc++"
target_compile_options(cvc5_parser PRIVATE -O2 -Wall)

install(TARGETS cvc5_parser RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
